_note: Seventh Heaven Pro factory library + Memo genre selections, parsed verbatim from the KB. Re-run build_knowledge.py after editing the article. Reverb preset names/numbers are never invented — they come from here.
always: 100% wet on a dedicated FX return; level ridden by the send.

classical.name: Concert Hall
classical.notes: Low modulation, stable. VLF off or -20dB. Late Rolloff 4-5kHz.

classical.name: Boston Hall A
classical.notes: Brighter, empty-hall character. Factory VLF only -2dB - cut aggressively.

classical.name: Piano Hall
classical.notes: 24ms pre-delay built in. VLF to -18dB+. Stereo send.

classical.name: Sunset Chamber
classical.notes: Factory VLF already -20dB. Low diffusion keeps character. Min 20ms pre-delay.

classical.name: Large Ambience
classical.notes: Very short - space without obvious tail. VLF down from -10dB.

jazz.name: Vocal Chamber
jazz.notes: Classic chamber. Pre-delay 20-40ms. Ducker on (Reverb mode).

celtic.name: Studio B Close
celtic.notes: Short, dense. Cut VLF from 0dB factory.

gospel.name: Sandors Hall
gospel.notes: Factory VLF -14dB - can bring to -10dB for gospel weight.

gospel.name: Vocal Shimmer
gospel.notes: V2 bloom. Baked delay 236ms - part of the shimmer.

fsq_logic.default: minimal-to-none — most FSQ shows take no reverb send
fsq_logic.when_used: short and bright; Rooms/Plates over long Halls; decay near factory
fsq_logic.vlf: nearer factory (no 60-315Hz room buildup to fight)
fsq_logic.early_late: Late carries more work outdoors — Equal to about -6 dB; Early still MAX

memo_tweak_priorities: VLF — cut hard from factory (room reinforces 60-315Hz)
Early/Late — Early MAX, pull Late down toward -20/OFF
